text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Whew. Keep it going. 
Just one more rep at this pace...!

One day toward the end of summer training 
camp, 
I happened to witness Mejiro Dober 
training.

And it was only natural. As our upcoming 
rival in 
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, she had 
already proven her mettle 
on the Tiara path—a most formidable 
"predecessor."

We are the "challengers." 
Fighting for the throne of "Queen" against 
an opponent clearly superior. 
It wasn't hard to foresee how brutal a 
battle it would be.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Are you anxious?

I knew better than to be overly 
optimistic. 
Yet, having stood by Phalaenopsis and 
supported her journey— 
I believed in her completely.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to it. Seeing you 
become Queen.

I'm really excited. To see you crowned 
Queen.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. That is well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now, then. 
Shall we apply ourselves as well?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...What is it? 
Looking upon me with such eyes, what have 
you to say?

Heading into the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, 
I made a declaration to Phalaenopsis with 
firm resolve.
choice_data_list:
"I'm going to put you through 'ultimate' 
conditioning."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ho... The ultimate. And specifically, 
what do you intend to do?
choice_data_list:
What we're doing isn't fundamentally 
different from usual. Except...

text_block_list.text:
We push beyond what Phalaenopsis considers 
tolerable. 
We raise the bar we set for ourselves one 
notch higher, 
and then even further still.
choice_data_list: You can do it, can't you?
I know you're capable of this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Give me everything you've got, Trainer. 
I'll show you results beyond your wildest 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Timer
text_block_list.text: ...Beep! Pip, pip, pip, pip...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Phalaenopsis! 
Keep it up! Don't let your pace drop!

From that day on, time flew by with an 
intensity 
that surpassed even our Classic Year 
summer training camp.

For instance, we held interval training on 
an incline. 
Using a steep hill at the edge of the 
beach, 
she ran repeated laps up and down the 
slope.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Whew. That makes 100, right?

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Great job, Phalaenopsis-san! 
Just 100 more laps! Keep at it!

Take her 200 inner laps at the club dojo, 
for example. 
Even on days when her body temperature ran 
backwards, 
she never skipped low-intensity training 
at the club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're here. Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right! 
Today, Phalaenopsis-san...!

Or the matched pace training, where we 
reached out to 
horse girls she knew, honing her skills 
against far more 
formidable rivals than ever before.
choice_data_list: (—All to win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.)

text_block_list.text:
And so, the latter half of summer camp 
passed 
in a blur of intense, relentless days—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, Phalaenopsis...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Mejiro Dober. 
Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Morning.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: What brings you out here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nothing much... Just looking at the 
flowers. 
I didn't know this camp had roses.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. 
They truly are exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Though... with this heat, 
it looks like the soil is quite parched.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'll go grab a watering can.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Allow me to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Look at the roses. 
Don't they look a little livelier now?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed they do. 
It is the reward for your dedication.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's really not that big a deal, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You know, roses kind of remind me of 
Air Groove-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Strong, cool, true to herself... 
That's why I looked up to her. And why I 
envied her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How she blew wide-open paths through the 
Twinkle Series by sheer force of will 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I kept running believing that if I could 
just be like her, 
I'd finally become someone worthy of the 
Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
———And now, here I am, standing in that 
future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even after beating Senpai, though... I 
realized 
I could never be a rose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That kind of strong, gallant... reigning 
queen 
just isn't in my nature.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even so... Phalaenopsis.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No. —Phalaenopsis.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not giving an inch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm probably more like a plumeria. 
I can't be an overwhelming queen like a 
rose— 
or an orchid like you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'll face you just as I am. 
As the reigning queen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So you'd better brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—The grand bloom of Mejiro who claimed the 
throne 
from Air Groove and reigns supreme over 
the tiaras.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The "strong me" will be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To think I would exchange arrows with Lady 
Dober 
in such a clash. Well now—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: It sets my blood surging all the more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of Lady Dober's 
achievements. 
Her prowess, her storied track... I cannot 
lightly 
claim to rival them.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I shall speak no idle words. 
With absolute, inevitable resolve—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I shall defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yes. In due time, 
I shall present you with a yellow musk 
pink.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Nothing could be more fitting to offer 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...A musk pink is just a carnation, 
right? And a yellow one means—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I got it. —I'll accept it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if Air Groove-senpai 
felt this way back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this: the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. 
I'm not going to lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —I'm heading on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Phalaeno. 
Did you know? Or was it just a 
coincidence?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I gave one to Air Groove-senpai in the 
past 
too, you know? A yellow carnation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Along with my resolve: 'I will surpass 
you.'

And so, with summer training camp at an 
end, we traveled back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I knew it well, Trainer... 
Lady Dober will be no easy foe.
choice_data_list:
Still, beating someone like that is what 
makes it worthwhile, right?

Still, beating someone like that is what 
makes it worthwhile, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Indeed. 
That is the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thus, when I cut her down— 
I shall truly prove my prowess.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have come to think quite 
to my liking, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Maybe I've been influenced by my master.

text_block_list.text:
I no longer had the doubts of my past. 
Bearing responsibility, 
shouldering her future—I declared my 
resolve.
choice_data_list: I will make you the queen.
I will make you the queen.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. 
You have become dependable indeed. Truly.

Summer has passed—making way for an autumn 
every bit as fiery. 
And waiting there is a throne worthy of 
her majesty.
Let us go and claim it, together.
